## Summary

<!--
Draft. What it should land on is open in issue #5.
-->

- Infectious disease modelling turns late, messy data into estimates,
  forecasts and scenarios
- Agents are language models with tools, working in a loop
- They can read data, implement, optimise and review. That frees our
  time for judgement
- They get things wrong, and evaluation is easy to fool. Review is still
  needed
